articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Spidercam debate rumbles on as four semifinalists confirmed
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition as we now know our four World Cup semifinalists.

articles.headline: Gianni Infantino says FIFA will examine possibility of 64-team World Cup
articles.description: Gianni Infantino has confirmed FIFA will discuss expanding the men's World Cup to 64 teams after the 2026 tournament, saying every nation should have the chance to dream of playing at football's biggest event.

articles.headline: FIFA, FIFPRO discussing heat protocols after World Cup concerns - sources
articles.description: FIFA and global players' union FIFPRO are in discussions over establishing protocols to avoid games being played in excessive heat, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: FIFA's top four teams make World Cup semifinals for first time
articles.description: Argentina, Spain, France and England went into the tournament as the top four in FIFA's rankings and are two wins away from being crowned champions again.

articles.headline: Harry Kane: England must find 'missing piece' ahead of World Cup semifinal vs. Argentina
articles.description: Harry Kane has urged England to find the "missing piece" and get over the line in the quest for World Cup glory, but accepts Thomas Tuchel's demand for improvements.

articles.headline: Xhaka: Switzerland red card vs. Argentina 'killed the game'
